action: I duck low behind the brambles and creep around the owlbear, keeping downwind and out of its sight.
I lower my bow, hold out an open hand and speak low and steady to calm the beast so it lets me pass.
I loose an arrow at the owlbear's chest.
I put the kettle on and sit by the hearth, thinking it over.
I nod to Wollandora and ask her why she called me here.
I stop, hold my breath and listen hard to work out what is coming through the trees.
I think back on the elven tales I grew up with, trying to recall what the old songs say of these relics.
I stay flat in the bushes and search the bank and the woods for anyone else lurking out there.
I cast Detect Magic on the crate.
I cast Charm Person on Reinhard so he lowers his blade and hears me out.

narrative: The owlbear has its head down in a deer carcass, tearing at it, its back to Thalbern. Rain hammers the leaves and drowns every other sound.
action: I creep past behind it while it feeds.

narrative: A storm breaks over the forest. Thunder rolls without a pause and rain hammers the canopy so hard that Thalbern can barely hear his own steps.
action: I listen for what is moving out there in the dark.

narrative: A dart stings Thalbern's neck. A cold numbness spreads from it and his knees start to give.
action: I clamp my jaw and fight to stay on my feet as the poison takes hold.
I draw my shortsword and slash at the owlbear's flank.
I drop my bow and punch the owlbear square in the beak.

narrative: The owlbear has its head down in a deer carcass, tearing at it, its back to Thalbern. It has not noticed him.
action: I put an arrow between its shoulders before it knows I am here.
I rest a hand on my sword hilt and tell Wollandora I am listening.

narrative: Reinhard draws his blade and comes at Lyra across the deck.
action: I cast Ray of Frost at Reinhard.

narrative: Branka staggers back from the blades, bleeding from a deep cut along her arm.
action: I call out a Healing Word to close Branka's wound.

narrative: Thalbern's boot sinks on a hidden plate among the roots. A jet of flame roars out of a carved stone mouth beside the path, straight at him.
action: I throw myself clear of the flames.

narrative: A viper strikes from the leaf litter and sinks its fangs into Thalbern's calf. Its venom burns up his leg and his sight starts to swim.
action: I grit my teeth and fight off the venom.

narrative: Reinhard draws his blade and comes at them across the bank.
action: I hook his ankle and throw my shoulder into him to knock him flat on his back.

narrative: A weighted hunter's net drops from the branches and tangles Thalbern's arms and legs. He is caught fast in it.
action: I tear at the net and wrench myself out of it.

narrative: The viper's venom is in Thalbern's blood. His hands shake and the trees swim in front of him.
action: I loose an arrow at the owlbear's chest.

narrative: The owlbear's feet go out from under it on the wet roots and it crashes onto its side.
action: I rush in and drive my shortsword into it before it can rise.

narrative: The owlbear rears over Thalbern with both claws raised and comes down at him.
action: I do not strike back. I watch its claws and duck and weave to avoid every blow.

narrative: The owlbear and Thalbern trade blows in the open on the deer trail. It snaps its beak an arm's length from his face.
action: I back away from it with my guard up, careful to give it no opening as I get out of its reach.

narrative: The owlbear crashes through the brush a stone's throw behind Thalbern, shrieking.
action: I put my head down and sprint flat out down the deer trail to open the gap.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. The thug squares up to Branka with a cudgel, his back half turned to Milos.
action: I wave my staff in the thug's face and shout to pull his eyes off Branka, so her next swing lands.
I hold the lantern close and steady for Branka while she searches the crate, pointing out what I notice.

narrative: Reinhard draws his blade and comes at them across the bank. The fight is on.
action: I drop behind the stacked crates and go still, out of his sight, so I can strike from cover.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. The thug's cudgel has left Branka bloodied and breathing hard.
action: I draw on my Second Wind, then bring my warhammer down on the thug.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. The thug squares up to Branka with a cudgel.
action: I bring my warhammer down on the thug.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. The thug's cudgel has left Branka bloodied and breathing hard.
action: I step back out of the press and catch my breath, drawing on my Second Wind.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. The thug squares up to Branka with a cudgel.
action: I sing a quick verse to put heart into Branka, then thrust my rapier at the thug.

narrative: Reinhard draws his blade and comes at Lyra across the deck.
action: I cast Magic Missile and send every dart into Reinhard.

narrative: Reinhard draws his blade and comes at Lyra across the deck. She has already spent the last of her power on two spells.
action: I cast Charm Person on Reinhard.

narrative: Reinhard draws his blade and comes at Lyra across the deck. She has already spent the last of her power on two spells.
action: I cast Ray of Frost at Reinhard.

narrative: The deck is quiet and the crate sits before Lyra, unguarded. She has already spent the last of her power on two spells.
action: I sit down by the crate and take ten slow minutes to cast Detect Magic over it as a ritual.

narrative: Reinhard draws his blade and comes at Lyra across the deck.
action: I cast Fireball at Reinhard.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. The thug squares up to Branka with a cudgel.
action: I call down Sacred Flame on the thug.
I cast Light on the tip of my staff so we can see the deck.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. Branka staggers back from the thug's cudgel, bleeding from a cut along her arm.
action: I call out a Healing Word to Branka, then bring my quarterstaff down on the thug.

narrative: Steel rings in the warehouse. The thug squares up to Branka with a cudgel.
action: I raise my holy symbol and cast Bless on Branka and on myself.
I draw my shortsword, charge the owlbear and slash at it.
I stay where I am and loose an arrow at the owlbear's chest.

narrative: The owlbear is on top of Thalbern, close enough to rake him.
action: I back well away from the owlbear, out of its reach, and put an arrow in it.
I turn and sprint down the trail back toward home as fast as I can run.

narrative: The owlbear is on top of Thalbern, close enough to rake him.
action: I hold my ground and loose an arrow straight into the owlbear's face.
Poppen slips out of the bushes and creeps down to the reeds by the gangway, keeping low and quiet.

narrative: Reinhard and Silas have backed off to the far end of the pier, a hundred feet from Lyra, in plain sight under the lantern.
action: Lyra casts Ray of Frost at Reinhard.

narrative: Branka is bleeding from a deep cut across her arm.
action: Wrenna hurries over to Branka and lays a hand on her arm, casting Cure Wounds.
I bar the door, eat a little, and sleep until morning.
I sit by the hearth for an hour, bind my cuts and catch my breath before I pack.

narrative: The owlbear roars and charges across the clearing at Thalbern.
action: I lie down in the ferns and sleep for the night.
